{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign en_a = (~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0]) |
                  (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (sel == 4'd1);
    assign en_c = (sel == 4'd2);
    assign en_d = (sel == 4'd3);
    assign en_e = (sel == 4'd4);
    assign en_f = (sel == 4'd5);
    assign en_g = (sel == 4'd6);
    assign en_h = (sel == 4'd7);
    assign en_i = (sel == 4'd8);
    assign en_j = (sel == 4'd9);

    always @* begin
        block_out = (block_a & {8{en_a}}) |
                    (block_b & {8{en_b}}) |
                    (block_c & {8{en_c}}) |
                    (block_d & {8{en_d}}) |
                    (block_e & {8{en_e}}) |
                    (block_f & {8{en_f}}) |
                    (block_g & {8{en_g}}) |
                    (block_h & {8{en_h}}) |
                    (block_i & {8{en_i}}) |
                    (block_j & {8{en_j}});
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline is select-path limited: selection decoding, high-fanout buffering, and the final data-combining logic produce a 1.04 ns maximum arrival. The default-to-block_a path is a particular opportunity to simplify selection logic.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit mutually exclusive data enables and a parallel masked-OR mux. Compute block_a's enable directly as select zero or any select from 10 through 15, rather than deriving its default enable by excluding all other case matches. This exposes a shallow sum-of-products implementation to technology mapping.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce default-selection logic depth and improve select-to-output arrival relative to 1.04 ns. No mapped candidate results are available, so a numerical gain or timing improvement is not established.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared enables drive eight data bits each, and the parallel combining network may require buffering or gate upsizing. The rewrite is intended to remain near the baseline area, but compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires the specified mapping and STA flow; neither has been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, unsigned port widths, and combinational output. Select values 0 through 9 choose block_a through block_j; values 10 through 15 choose block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state select value. There are no parameters, clocks, storage, latency, external dependencies, or input assumptions. Four-state X/Z simulation equivalence is not claimed."
}
